description: AGSC-06-18: the TDMRep policy is served at /.well-known/tdmrep.json, the only route that carries it (no /tdmrep.json), as a JSON artefact in JCS form with one LF (AGSC-04-04). A reservation of 1 is accompanied by one robots.txt group User-agent: <token> with Disallow: / per token of site.tdm_crawlers[], in configuration order and before the User-agent: * group, and no Disallow for any other token; a Bundle whose prose carries another licence publishes tdm-reservation 0 and no crawler group. Derivation over the minimal fixture built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history, in two sub-cases: as it is (the Content Use Terms, six tokens) and with CC-BY-4.0 as its prose licence (configuration and root document). reservation_for_paths gives, for each path, the tdm-reservation of the first rule of the file whose location pattern matches it under the TDM Reservation Protocol (a prefix match in which * stands for any characters and a final $ ends the pattern): every path of the node is reserved in the first sub-case and not reserved in the second. The location strings themselves are not pinned. robots_disallow_all_groups lists the user agents of the groups that carry Disallow: /, in file order; the * group never does.
